transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because... well, I drive for a living, and dispatch and compliance have been tracking my route changes. They do it through the computer system, and I hear these little comments on the radio. People try to tell me it's just normal oversight, but I know it's not. I can just tell that certain other drivers are reporting on me.
About how long have you been noticing this happening?

It's been about two months. That's when it all became really clear to me, anyway—the tracking through the computer system and the comments on the radio. So yeah, I've been noticing it for the past two months.
Do you ever hear voices or comments when the radio is turned off and you are completely alone?

No, not really. If the radio is off and I'm completely alone, I don't hear anything. It's really just when the system is on and I'm working. When everything is shut down and I'm by myself, it's just quiet.
Are you currently using any substances, medications, or drugs to help you stay awake or get through your driving shifts?
No, I don't use anything like that. I mean, I drink coffee, just regular coffee, but I don't take any pills or drugs or anything to stay awake. I just do my job.

Have you ever felt that an outside force or person was controlling your body or making you act against your will?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I mean, I'm the one making my own decisions and moving my own body. Nobody else is controlling me or making me do things I don't want to do. I'm in control of myself.
